clocks.label: Whale wakes
clocks.completion_consequence: The glass whale wakes irreversibly. The settlement names an earned cost and a new active consequence for Orra; waking alone cannot carry Orra to the sea.

clocks.label: Wells fail
clocks.completion_consequence: The remaining wells cease to provide usable water. The loss persists and the settlement names the resulting active scarcity, obligation, or alternative supply.

clocks.label: Bell is answered
clocks.completion_consequence: The western bell receives a canonical answer that identifies what answered or why. Its original mystery closes even when the answer creates a new active consequence.
